Acid Blood..description: Melee attackers take half the HP lost in return as acid damage.
Acid Blood..name: Acid Blood.

Blinding Spit..description: Spits a blinding substance at a target within range. The target must make a save or be blinded for 1 round.
Blinding Spit..name: Blinding Spit.

Bloodthirsty..description: Has advantage on attacks against Bloodied targets.
Bloodthirsty..name: Bloodthirsty.

Brawler..description: Extra damage, can only attack in melee.
Brawler..name: Brawler.

Brute..description: Attacks also knockback a number of spaces equal to the primary die rolled.
Brute..name: Brute.

Burning Aura..description: Creatures that start their turn adjacent to this monster take 1d6 fire damage.
Burning Aura..name: Burning Aura.

Disintegrating Armor..description: Starts with Heavy Armor, on crit degrades to Medium, then to none.
Disintegrating Armor..name: Disintegrating Armor.

Explosive Death..description: Explode on death, dealing 2d6 damage to creatures within reach.
Explosive Death..name: Explosive Death.

FAST..description: Reaction: 1/round. Force a reroll with disadvantage on an attack.
FAST..name: FAST.

Fearsome..description: Frighten enemies within Range on a failed WIL save. 1/encounter.
Fearsome..name: Fearsome.

Flying..description: Flying speed and immune to Opportunity Attacks. May FALL when crit (1d6 damage/10 ft. fallen, and lands Prone).
Flying..name: Flying.

Formation..description: Armor increases 1 step for each adjacent ally (None, Med, Heavy).
Formation..name: Formation.

Frenzied..description: Deals extra damage or has faster speed while damaged.
Frenzied..name: Frenzied.

Gravity Manipulator..description: Can pull or push enemies within reach.
Gravity Manipulator..name: Gravity Manipulator.

Hypnotic Gaze..description: Forces enemies to make a WIL save or be confused for 1 round.
Hypnotic Gaze..name: Hypnotic Gaze.

Mounted..description: Faster movement and deals extra damage after moving toward an enemy.
Mounted..name: Mounted.

Obstinate..description: When attacking a target with disadvantage, treat the roll as if it had advantage instead.
Obstinate..name: Obstinate.

Pack Tactics..description: Advantage on attacks when an ally is adjacent to the target.
Pack Tactics..name: Pack Tactics.

Parry..description: Attacks against them miss on a 1 and 2.
Parry..name: Parry.

Ranged..description: Extra damage; can only attack at range.
Ranged..name: Ranged.

Retaliate..description: Attacks the first creature who attacks them in melee each round.
Retaliate..name: Retaliate.

Silencer..description: Attacks silence enemies (making them unable to cast spells or perform other actions that requires the voice).
Silencer..name: Silencer.

Size Up/Spot Weakness/Pin Down..description: DEX save, the next attack you make is with advantage and cannot be Interposed.
Size Up/Spot Weakness/Pin Down..name: Size Up/Spot Weakness/Pin Down.

Spiked..description: When hit by a melee attack, the attacker takes 1d4 piercing damage in return.
Spiked..name: Spiked.

Standard Bearer..description: Buffs nearby allies, reducing the damage they take or increasing the damage they do (see Kobold Clanger or Doomsayer Cultist).
Standard Bearer..name: Standard Bearer.

Sturdy/Undying..description: The first time the monster would die, they have 1 HP instead.
Sturdy/Undying..name: Sturdy/Undying.

Summoner..description: Calls minions to their aid each round.
Summoner..name: Summoner.

Terrible Roar/Creepy Monologue/Taunt..description: Creatures (or a creature) who hear this make a WIL save or are Frightened for 1 turn.
Terrible Roar/Creepy Monologue/Taunt..name: Terrible Roar/Creepy Monologue/Taunt.

Tricky..description: Can swap places with allies or enemies.
Tricky..name: Tricky.

Webslinger..description: Can immobilize a target with webs when hit or crit.
Webslinger..name: Webslinger.

Wind Up/Breathe In..description: Regain the use of a single use ability.
Wind Up/Breathe In..name: Wind Up/Breathe In.
